newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy Q4 total sales decline.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy Q4 total sales decline.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said Thursday sales for its 13-week fourth quarter ended March 1 declined nine percent to $2.35 billion from $2.58 billion for the 14-week quarter last year.
Compared with the first 13 weeks of the year-ago fourth quarter, current fourth quarter sales were down four percent, it added.

Fiscal 1997 sales of $7.77 billion for 52 weeks were up eight percent compared to 7.22 billion for the 53-week fiscal 1996 year. Compared with the first 52 weeks of fiscal 1996, sales were up 10 percent, Best Buy said.
Best Buy, which sells name brand consumer electronics, personal computers and home office products, said it expects to release its fiscal 1997 earnings on April 9.
